s: Im happoalim mechuyyabim lebarek, ubo seip echad: poalim sekire yom haosim melaka etzel baal habbayit — meqatztzerin bebirkat hammazon, kede shello lebattel mimmeleket baal habbayit, shebbishat birkat hammazon i epshar laasoq bimlaka, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"g. Ketzad? Beraka rishona ketiqqunah, sheniyya poteach bebirkat haaretz vekolel bah "boneh yerushalayim" vechotem bebirkat haaretz, mippene shebbirkat haaretz u"boneh yerushalayim" hen domot, laken kolelan bibraka achat, shemminyan habberakot enan min hattora, ki bibraka achat shekkolel bah meen sheloshtan yotze yede chobato min hattora, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"ch, ella mosheh vihoshua vedavid ushelomoh tiqqenu matbea sheloshtan, umishshum bittul meleket baal habbayit heqellu. Uberaka rebiit sheiqqarah middibre soperim - en happoalim omerim otah kelal, ben shemmebarekin, ben sheshshomein mippi acher hamzammen umebarek birkat hammazon ketiqqunah — hare hen omedin limlaktam keshechotem birkat yerushalayim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennotelim sakar al melaktam millebad seudatan, abal im en notelim sakar ella hasseuda sheokelim lebad — mebarekin kol had' berakot ketiqqunan. Veken im baal habbayit meseb immahem basseuda, ap al pi shennotelim sakar millebad hasseuda — mebarekin kol d' berakot. Veakshav leolam mebarekin kol d' berakot, lepi sheen derek bene adam lehaqpid bekak, umin hassetam al daat ken sokerim poalim, sheyyebareku kol had' berakot:
